name: AionUi
headline: AionUi: Open-Source Coworking Tool for AI Agents
short_description: AionUi is a versatile, open-source coworking tool designed for integration with various AI models like Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex. It enhances productivity by enabling multi-agent collaboration in a user-friendly web interface.
author: iOfficeAI

sections.overview:
AionUi is a versatile open-source tool designed to facilitate multi-agent collaboration through a user-friendly web interface. It integrates with various AI models including Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex, allowing teams to coordinate AI agents within a unified workspace. The platform enhances team productivity by streamlining how multiple AI agents work together on shared tasks. AionUi provides a coworking environment where AI agents can be deployed and managed collaboratively, making it ideal for teams that leverage multiple AI models.
Conduct collaborative coding sessions with real-time feedback from AI models.
Utilize AI assistance for efficient project management and task tracking.
Perform real-time code reviews to enhance code quality and team collaboration.
Integrate multiple AI tools to create streamlined workflows tailored to team needs.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install iOfficeAI/AionUi`
`git clone https://github.com/iOfficeAI/AionUi`
sections.usage:
```
Set up a multi-agent collaboration in AionUi to draft a blog post about [TOPIC]. Assign one agent to research, one to outline, and one to write. Use Type for real-time collaboration and feedback. Ensure the final draft is optimized for [TARGET_AUDIENCE].
```
Copy

```
The multi-agent collaboration in AionUi has successfully drafted a blog post about 'The Future of Remote Work.' The research agent gathered the latest statistics and trends, the outline agent structured the content into an engaging narrative, and the writing agent produced a polished draft. The final post is optimized for tech-savvy professionals and includes actionable insights and data-driven recommendations. The collaboration in Type allowed for seamless feedback and real-time edits, ensuring a cohesive and high-quality final product.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
